notes.title: Demo v0.1.54 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed the "Upstanding Citizen" achievement, which is now unlockable and functions as intended

Corrected the Mitosic Arrow weapon stat card to display critical chance instead of showing attack speed twice

Tweaked button mapping on the Wishlist screen so that moving left or right now takes you directly to the "Exit Game" button

Replaced expired Discord invite link
